The album cover features The Beatles in colorful military-style band uniforms standing among cardboard cutouts of famous figures. In terms of who is holding a trumpet, I need to think carefully about the specific instruments held by each Beatle on this cover.

Paul McCartney is indeed holding a cor anglais (English horn), not a trumpet. However, the other agents have identified Paul McCartney with high confidence. Let me reconsider - on the cover, the Beatles are holding various instruments as part of their band uniforms.
